categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in convenience store retailing under the 7-ELEVEN brand, along with related retail sectors including supermarkets, drugstores, coffee shops (Starbucks), logistics services, and e-commerce platforms. It also engages in diversified retail such as cosmetics, daily necessities, and food services, supported by a broad network of stores and digital platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as AI-powered smart shelves with LiDAR imaging for cashier-less shopping experiences, integrated digital payment systems, and a comprehensive logistics and supply chain management system. It emphasizes fresh food innovation, cold chain logistics, and digital retail platforms like iOPEN Mall and mobile ordering services to enhance customer convenience and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are general consumers across Taiwan and overseas markets, including the Philippines and China, served through convenience stores, supermarkets, and digital platforms. The company targets daily consumer needs for food, beverages, household goods, and lifestyle products, as well as business clients through logistics and supply chain services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in Taiwan with over 7,000 7-ELEVEN stores and additional retail outlets nationwide. It also has significant presence in the Philippines with over 4,000 stores, and in China (Shanghai and Zhejiang) with more than 500 stores. The company is expanding its digital and physical footprint in these key Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily downstream in the retail supply chain, managing extensive retail outlets and direct consumer sales. It also controls midstream logistics and distribution through its own logistics subsidiaries, ensuring supply chain integration from procurement to end-customer delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding multi-format retail stores, enhancing fresh food offerings, integrating AI and digital technologies for retail innovation, and deepening membership and digital ecosystem development (OPENPOINT). The company invests in sustainability initiatives, carbon reduction, and supply chain traceability, alongside continuous product and service innovation to meet evolving consumer trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales at convenience stores, supermarkets, and affiliated retail outlets. Additional income streams include logistics and delivery services, franchise fees, digital platform transactions, membership programs, and licensing fees related to brand and service offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in Taiwan's convenience store sector with a 51.82% market share, competing against major players like FamilyMart, Hi-Life, and OK Mart. It is recognized as the top brand by consumers and maintains competitive advantages through scale, innovation, integrated logistics, and a strong digital ecosystem.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$337.9 billion in 2024, representing a 6.59% growth over the previous year, with net income attributable to the parent company rising 8.72% to NT$11.54 billion. Total store count exceeded 13,000 including overseas operations, reflecting steady expansion and robust financial performance with improving profitability and asset base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes convenience, product diversity, and quality, offering differentiated fresh food, exclusive branded collaborations, and innovative digital services such as AI-enabled shopping and integrated membership rewards. Its extensive store network combined with advanced logistics and digital platforms delivers superior customer experience and accessibility, positioning it as a comprehensive lifestyle service platform.
